text: Write a try-with-resources block with two resources and show the closing order. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: final String n; Res(String n) { this.n = n; System.out.println("open " + n); }
answer: implements AutoCloseable|public void close()|try (Res first = new Res("first"); Res second = new Res("second"))
explanation: Verified: open first, open second, body, close second, close first. Reverse of acquisition, which is the correct order whenever the later resource depends on the earlier — closing a writer before the stream it wraps, for instance. One interface and one method is all it takes to participate, and any class holding something that needs releasing should.
